name: DiscordDeck
author: Lexodeus

publish.description: Adds Discord to the Steam menu. Opens Discord or Vesktop (Vencord) installed from Discover without adding it as a non-Steam game.

Changelog:
## 0.2.2 (2026-10-24)

- The controller layout is also set up for the Steam Controller, for example on a Steam Machine. Before, DiscordDeck only set it up for the Steam Deck's own controls.
